tuned_on: fold 1 only: free fit on fold-1 training (2021-22 + 2022-23), grid cells refit W at fixed s and predict 2023-24 (fold-1 test); LL per game paired game-block bootstrap (1,000) SE vs the best cell; R = D32 slope ratio on ES rows, deciles of the row's as-of rating (200 boots for the grid CI)
selection: among the 14 cells within 2 SE of the best LL, the smallest max(|log R_for|, |log R_against|); ties within 0.02 to Qr (fewer inputs), then m closest to 1
